scientific_role: Provider-exposed local cumulative-admissibility sigma surface constructed from provider-local evidence and consumed unchanged by M0 and M1.
card_instance: I1_i=(A_i,W_i,R,{sigma_i(A_i,H;rho): H in H, rho in R})

local_metric_semantics.L_i: provider-local request arrival to provider completion, including provider queue waiting and service time
local_metric_semantics.C_i: native provider execution cost for the local request

sigma_semantics.c_i: cumulative fraction of provider-local decided requests in [0,H] admissible under A_i

workload_contract.semantics: same periodic root-request context as the frozen Phase-1 matched physical benchmark

R.method_consumption: M0 or M1 may later consume one or more already-exposed rho slices according to its own frozen method rule.

construction_rule.joint_finite_population: rows of T_i with finite L_i,C_i,Q_i
construction_rule.common_rank_family: A_i(k)={L_i<=L_(k),C_i<=C_(k),Q_i>=Q_[k]}, with L/C kth ascending and Q kth descending order statistics on the same joint-finite sample
construction_rule.selection: choose the smallest common rank k whose joint empirical coverage P_hat_Ti[(L_i,C_i,Q_i) in A_i(k)] is at least rho_G

A_i.note: rho_G parameterizes the deterministic trace-to-A_i construction. This is distinct from rho_i, which is not selected by Phase 2. After A_i is fixed for the global query, I1 still exposes the complete frozen R surface.
